name: @pipeworx/mcp-iplookup

tools.name: geolocate_ip
tools.description: Look up an IP address to find its location and network details. Returns country, region, city, coordinates, timezone, ISP, and AS number. Use when you need to identify where a user or server is located.

tools.name: batch_geolocate
tools.description: Look up locations for up to 100 IP addresses at once. Returns geolocation and ISP data in the same order as input. Use for analyzing multiple IPs efficiently.

ips.description: Array of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses to look up (maximum 100)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-iplookup forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the iplookup pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
